name: Grand Hyatt Beijing
positioning: Contemporary hotel in a curved glass tower at Oriental Plaza on Wangfujing, within walking distance of the Forbidden City
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square
Guests who want a resort-style indoor pool in the city center

facts.text: The hotel is on Wangfujing, within walking distance of the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square.
The hotel is part of Oriental Plaza, with direct access to the adjacent shopping mall.
The hotel is a curved glass tower.
The hotel blends western and oriental traditions with contemporary design.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of historic Beijing.
Rooms have wood accents, goose-down duvets, marble bathrooms and Chinese artwork.
Rooms feature Bose speakers, Dyson hairdryers and Balmain toiletries in large eco-friendly bottles.
The Residence Suite includes a kitchen and a private spa room.
Access to the Club Oasis indoor pool is complimentary for all in-house guests.
The Club Oasis spa offers body and facial treatments and manicures.
The fitness center is equipped by Technogym and guided by a professional coaching team.
Made in China serves Beijing classics, including its signature Peking duck.

highlights.text: The Club Oasis indoor pool is resort-style, surrounded by tropical plants, waterfalls, pillars, stone grottos and underwater music.
The 17th-floor Grand Club lounge looks north over the Forbidden City and south over Chang'an Avenue.
The Mansion Suite, on the top floor, has panoramic views of traditional hutong architecture and the city beyond.
The Duplex Capital Suite spans two floors, with a two-story atrium living room and views of Chang An Avenue.

considerations.text: Under Beijing government guidelines, hotels cannot place single-use items such as toothbrushes, combs and razors in rooms.
Beijing Capital International Airport is 28 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the large hotel size may feel less intimate.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Grand Hyatt Beijing
